responsibility: Implements the native D mangling and demangling support used for linker-visible names and type decoration. It initializes the per-type mangling alphabet, serializes modifiers, types, parameters, expressions, symbols, string literals, arrays, structs, and template instances into D mangled form with back-reference compression, exposes the `mangleExact` and `mangleToBuffer` entry points, and supports reverse lookup of already-interned decorated types via `decoToType`.
